retention_policy._TODO: Set retention_months to the legally/operationally decided value before going live. Zero means the DPDP retention job will not delete any photos until this is configured. Consult your legal/compliance advisor — this value is intentionally left as 0 (no-op) rather than assuming any specific duration. See DPDP Act note in towing_dispatch_spec_v9.md §Part 2.

_setup_note: Fill businessName, gstin, registeredAddress, and the approved Meta authentication templateName/languageCode before Phase 3 goes live. Empty WhatsApp template fields intentionally make OTP sending fail closed. The invoiceNumberCounter is incremented atomically by a Firestore transaction in the invoicing Cloud Function — never edit it manually. otpPolicy and whatsappOtpTemplate are tunable non-secret operational configuration; OTP_PEPPER remains a Secret Manager secret and must never be stored here.
